samples.prompt: Write a proposal for improving a shared university study room. Give reasons for your suggestions. Write 120–180 words.
samples.text:
A shared study room should support both individual work and discussion. At present, these activities take place around the same tables, which makes concentration difficult. I would divide the room into two clearly marked areas and add movable screens between them. Students could then choose a suitable place without leaving the building.

The university should also ask students to report broken chairs and sockets through a simple online form. Repairing existing equipment would be less expensive than replacing everything at once. A short trial period would help staff discover whether the new arrangement works.

These improvements are modest, but they address daily problems directly. By listening to students and reviewing the results, the university could create a study space that is practical, welcoming and easier for everyone to use.
samples.humanExpectation: 允许完整表达，无错误时不强造批注
